Specifically, the upstream metal-fx implementation consumes the `liquidMetal`
fragment shader from `@paper-design/shaders` version 0.0.80. GS's Android
implementation is a derived port of that shader's equations to AGSL and a CPU
bitmap fallback; it is not an unmodified copy of the upstream shader source.
